name: MBDB
summary: A rare entactogenic drug and analogue of MDMA. Suspected to be first synthesised by David E. Nichols. The drug is suspected to be less potent than related drugs of its type. It is sometimes referred to as a 'watered down MDMA'.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: MBDB acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine releasing agent (SNRA).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin–norepinephrine releasing agent; Entactogen; Serotonergic neurotoxin

uses.text: MBDB was first synthesized by pharmacologist and medicinal chemist David E. Nichols and later tested by Alexander Shulgin and described in his book, PiHKAL: A Chemical Love Story.

sideEffects.en: Its effects resemble a milder MDMA, including jaw clenching, a faster heart rate, sweating, raised body temperature and a low mood afterwards. As a serotonin releaser it carries a risk of overheating and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 它的作用類似較溫和的 MDMA，包括咬緊牙關、心跳加快、出汗、體溫上升與事後情緒低落。作為血清素釋放劑，它有體溫過高與血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的作用类似较温和的 MDMA，包括咬紧牙关、心跳加快、出汗、体温上升与事后情绪低落。作为血清素释放剂，它有体温过高与血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: David Nichols, who first made MBDB, also coined the word entactogen, meaning touching within, to describe drugs like it and MDMA.
fact.zh: 最早合成 MBDB 的大衛．尼可斯也創造了「entactogen」（內感劑）一詞，意思是「觸及內在」，用來描述它與 MDMA 這類藥物。
fact.zhHans: 最早合成 MBDB 的大卫．尼可斯也创造了「entactogen」（内感剂）一词，意思是「触及内在」，用来描述它与 MDMA 这类药物。
